item.title: Podcast: Clean transportation as an AV vs. EV horse race
item.description: Manufacturers and fleets are pivoting their focus from climate goals to everyday operational efficiencies. How is ACT Expo going to capture the focus on economic sustainability?

item.title: Winter weather contributes to higher U.S. diesel and gas prices
item.description: Diesel climbs to $3.68 nationally, with the West Coast seeing the largest weekly increases for commercial fleets.

item.title: Roeth: Learning to safely share the road with trucks
item.description: Here are some tips for sharing the road with cars and commercial trucks more safely, with emphasis on speed control, stopping distances, and driver awareness.

item.title: Regulatory outlook for Trump vs. California this year
item.description: California faces ongoing conflicts with the federal government over driver and emissions standards. These legal and funding disputes will extend into 2026.

item.title: Capex comps: Carriers are still in careful-does-it mode
item.description: Among publicly traded companies that have reported their Q4 results, spending this year will be focused on replacements and “doing more with less.”

item.title: Trucking's emissions deregulation outlook for 2026
item.description: EPA is working to weaken truck emissions regulations this year: It is likely reducing Heavy-Duty NOx warranty requirements and repealing vehicle greenhouse gas standards altogether.

item.title: Winter storms drive record spot rate spikes across dry van, reefer, and flatbed markets
item.description: Winter weather tightened capacity and triggered record spot rate gains across dry van, refrigerated, and flatbed freight, according to FTR and DAT data.

item.title: Top risks for transportation and logistics in 2026: Cyberthreats, cargo theft, disruption
item.description: Cyberattacks, cargo theft, and supply chain disruption top the 2026 risk list, keeping transportation and logistics leaders up at night.

item.title: Class 8 orders defy trends with surprisingly strong start to 2026
item.description: With the average Class 8 truck age reaching a 12-year high and EPA 2027 looming, fleets start the year in a buying mood despite mixed economic signals.

item.title: PlusAI lands Traton funding, nears Nasdaq listing
item.description: The parent of International is backing the autonomous trucking company’s R&D work with up to $25 million. Shareholders of a SPAC are scheduled to vote next week on a PlusAI merger.
